coverage.member: FusionButton(#if NET48 this HtmlHelper<TModel> html, #else this IHtmlHelper<TModel> html, #endif ReactivePlan<TModel> plan, string elementId, Action<ButtonBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionButton render helper stops rendering the Syncfusion action button, so the check-in never shows the 'Begin check-in for Eleanor Whitfield' action the test asserts is visible on open

coverage.member: SetContent(this ComponentRef<FusionButton, TModel> self, string content)
coverage.catches: SetContent stops writing the personalised label, so on DomReady the action keeps its builder text 'Begin daily check-in' instead of becoming 'Begin check-in for Eleanor Whitfield' (the test asserts the action's visible text is the personalised label)

the Content() source stops reading the action's label back, so the visible 'Action ready' line does not show 'Begin check-in for Eleanor Whitfield' (the test asserts that line reads the label the source yields)

coverage.member: SetDisabled(this ComponentRef<FusionButton, TModel> self, bool disabled)
coverage.catches: SetDisabled stops changing the action's enabled state, so confirming identity leaves it disabled and locking leaves it enabled (the test asserts the action becomes enabled after Confirm and disabled again after Lock)

the Disabled() source stops yielding the action's locked state into the readiness condition, so the readiness message no longer switches between the locked and ready messages as the test asserts in sequence

coverage.member: SetPrimary(this ComponentRef<FusionButton, TModel> self, bool isPrimary)

coverage.member: SetToggle(this ComponentRef<FusionButton, TModel> self, bool isToggle)
coverage.catches: SetToggle stops making the action a toggle, so a subsequent Click() does not latch the active state and the action never gains 'e-active' (the test asserts e-active appears only after follow-up is enabled and the action is clicked)

Click() stops invoking the action's click, so the 'Remind me' control no longer latches the toggled action and 'e-active' never appears (the test asserts the action becomes active after Remind, distinct from the SetToggle assertion that it was not active before)
FocusIn() stops moving focus, so the 'Jump to the action' control does not focus the action button (the test asserts the action is not focused before Jump and is focused after)

the CssClass() source stops yielding the action's classes into the gather, so the server confirmation the care-team member sees no longer reports 'Priority style: e-warning urgent-visit' (the test asserts that exact priority style in the confirmation)

the IsPrimary() source stops yielding the recommended flag into the gather, so the confirmation no longer reads 'as the recommended next step' (the test asserts that recommended phrasing in the confirmation)
the IsToggle() source stops yielding the follow-up flag into the gather, so the confirmation no longer reads 'with a follow-up flagged' (the test asserts that follow-up phrasing in the confirmation)

acceptedFanout.reason: one record gesture with DISTINCT fails-when-broken substring assertions per read source in the server confirmation the care-team member sees: 'as the recommended next step' (IsPrimary), 'with a follow-up flagged' (IsToggle), and 'Priority style: e-warning urgent-visit' (CssClass). Three sources, three independent assertions in one confirmation string — not one assertion claimed for many members (3 <= cap 4, declared for clarity).
